lanes.summary: Deletion starts in the app and is explained clearly, but it takes a 4-second disabled button, a confirm sheet and then an email link. The account stays signed in until the email is confirmed.
steps: "Do you wish to delete your account?"

lanes.summary: Offline is a state, not an error: a quiet "YOU ARE OFFLINE" banner sits over the path. Only third-party sources say lessons in the current unit stay playable and sync later.

No in-app What's New screen tied to updates was observed. App Store release notes are a recurring joke about squashing bugs, not a list of changes. New features show up as promo screens and an opt-in Announcements push channel.
sources: Mobbin screen c8bef260-406c-4e6f-a958-bcb5402099fb ("Announcements: Updates about new features…")

lanes.summary: Lessons finish offline and sync later, and during site outages Duolingo pauses requests behind a maintenance page and repairs affected streaks afterwards. The AI Video Call has a daily cap that users say is not stated up front and can cut in early, and no in-app error screen was observed.
steps: Needs the server to save or reply
Progress shown now, sent on reconnect
Freeze applied to the missed day
Daily limit hit, users say mid-call
No typed work at risk in lessons

lanes.summary: Video Call and Roleplay send voice and text to OpenAI, and the privacy policy reportedly lets users stop sharing audio and turn off session-replay tracking in Settings. The observed Video Call flow starts with no consent step, and no screen of those toggles or of withdrawing was found.
steps: No AI-sharing notice in observed flow
Policy: opt out in app Settings

lanes.summary: SIGN OUT sits at the foot of Settings and lands on "Sign back in", a picker of accounts saved on this device with "Add another account" and MANAGE ACCOUNTS. That makes switching easy, but names and emails stay on screen after signing out. Cancelled or wrong sign-in screens were not observed; Help only covers the duplicate-account case.
steps: Help: may be a 2nd account; log out

lanes.summary: Progress lives on the account, so any device that signs in gets it, and offline sessions sync on reconnect. The Family Plan is managed in the app: invite by link or search, a confirm sheet, an owner-only Edit to remove someone, and Help says joining or leaving never touches progress or streak.
steps: "It's just you so far!" ADD MEMBERS
Search, link, share, or from device
"Add Alex Smith…?" ADD TO PLAN / NO THANKS
